# Tubi Live TV — Test Plan (M08)

**Generated by:** Playwright Test planner (live exploration of https://tubitv.com on 2026-10-21)
**Seed test:** `tests/seed.spec.ts` (fixture `tubiHome`, `toHaveTitle` web-first assertion)
**Generated test file (target):** `tests/m08/tubi-livetv.spec.ts`

> Scope: reachability from home, the channel guide, and clicking a channel to open the player.
> Each scenario below was checked against the live site; observations that differ from the
> prior draft of this plan are called out inline.

---

## Assumptions

- Fresh, signed-out browser state (no cookies, no account).
- Desktop viewport (default Playwright viewport).
- Live TV content is not guaranteed to be on air at a given time; scenarios assert on structure, not on a specific program.

---

## Scenario 1: Live TV is reachable from the home page

**Starting state:** fresh session at `https://tubitv.com/`.

**Steps**

1. Load the home page with `tubiHome.goto()`.
2. In the header menubar, activate the `Live TV` menu item (`TubiHomePage.browseMenuItem('Live TV')`, which resolves `getByRole('menuitem', { name: /Live TV/i })`).
3. Wait for the Live TV page to load.

**Expected outcomes**

- URL path is `/live`.
- Page title matches `/Watch Free Live TV, Movies and TV Shows Online \| Tubi/i`.
- A level-1 heading with text `Live TV` is visible.
- The header menubar is still visible.

**Success criteria:** all four expected outcomes hold.

**Failure conditions:** the menu item is absent from the home header; navigation lands on any path other than `/live`; the heading is missing.

**Observed during exploration:** the menubar item `Live TV` links to `/live`; the page heading is `Live TV`; the title matches the expected pattern.

---

## Scenario 2: Channel guide shows the category filters, time header, and program listings

**Starting state:** fresh session, navigated to `/live` (via `tubiLiveTv.goto()`).

**Steps**

1. Load the Live TV page with `tubiLiveTv.goto()`.
2. Wait for the guide to render (`tubiLiveTv.waitForChannelGuideLoaded()` is NOT reliable on production; see the note under Notes for the generator).
3. Inspect the guide region.

**Expected outcomes**

- A tablist named `Filter options` is visible.
- The first filter tab (`Featured`) is selected.
- The filter tablist contains more than one tab (observed: 27 tabs, including `Recommended`, `Sports On Now`, `Local News`, `Weather`).
- A row of time labels is visible in the guide (observed: half-hour labels such as `10:00 AM`, `10:30 AM`, ...).
- At least one program tile is visible in the guide grid. Tiles are `div[role="button"]` elements whose accessible name begins with `Select to view`, and one tile is labeled `Now playing`.

**Success criteria:** the tablist, the selected `Featured` tab, the time header, and at least one program tile are all visible.

**Failure conditions:** the guide never renders within 30 seconds; the tablist or time header is absent; no program tile is visible.

**Not verified:** the prior draft's threshold of "at least 10 channel rows". The site does not expose a `channel-list-item` test id (see Notes), and the row count per guide was not measured, so no numeric row threshold is asserted here.

---

## Scenario 3: Clicking a program in the guide starts playback in the Live TV player

**Starting state:** fresh session, navigated to `/live`, guide rendered (Scenario 2 preconditions).

**Steps**

1. Load the Live TV page with `tubiLiveTv.goto()`.
2. Note the current `src` of the `<video>` element on the page.
3. Click the first program tile whose accessible name starts with `Select to view` (`div[role="button"]` in the guide grid).
4. Wait up to 5 seconds.

**Expected outcomes**

- The URL is still `/live` (observed: no `/live/<id>` route exists on production; the prior draft's `/live/\d+` expectation did not match).
- The `<video>` element's `currentSrc` changes to a new `blob:` URL.
- The `<video>` element is visible and has `readyState` of at least 2 (HAVE_CURRENT_DATA) within the wait.
- No `[role="dialog"]` element appears.

**Success criteria:** the video source changes, the video element is visible, and the URL remains `/live`.

**Failure conditions:** the video `currentSrc` does not change; the video element is not visible; a navigation to an unexpected path occurs.

**Observed during exploration:** a DOM click on a `Select to view` tile changed the `<video>` source to a new blob URL after 3 seconds, with no URL change and no dialog. The first click was a DOM-level click via script, not a pointer click; the generator should confirm with a real pointer click.

---

## Suggested additions

- **Accessible names expose unrendered template strings.** Production exposes literal placeholders in `aria-label` values: `Select to view {programName}. {programDescription}`, `Now playing: {programName}`, and `{categoryName} filter` on every filter tab (about 210 occurrences in the Live TV `<main>` HTML). This is an accessibility defect and a likely cause of unstable test names. Not a test scenario yet; flag to the Tubi web team, and consider a scenario asserting that accessible names contain no `{...}` placeholders.
- **Channel guide auto-refreshes when a program ends.** Carried over from the prior draft. Not requested for this module; it was previously marked out of scope.

---

## Notes for the generator

- Use `tubiHome` for the home page and `tubiLiveTv` for the Live TV page, both from `shared/fixtures/index.js`.
- Navigate via the adapters: `tubiHome.browseMenuItem('Live TV')` in Scenario 1, `tubiLiveTv.goto()` in Scenarios 2 and 3. Do not use raw URLs in tests.
- **`data-testid="channel-list-item"` does not exist on production.** A DOM check on `https://tubitv.com/live` found zero elements with that test id. The prior plan's note "verified during planner exploration" is incorrect for the current site. `TubiLiveTvPage.channelRows` and `waitForChannelGuideLoaded()` will time out against production. The adapter needs a new locator (for example `div[role="button"][aria-label^="Select to view"]`) before tests can rely on it. Changes belong in the adapter only.
- The `TubiHomePage` comments already record that Tubi removed `data-testid` attributes from production in 2026, which is consistent with this finding.
- Use `page.getByRole('menuitem', ...)` for the menubar, `page.getByRole('tablist', { name: 'Filter options' })` for filters.
